# Evaluation

Every number on this page comes from `packages/bench` output (CLAUDE.md). Re-run the benchmarks with `pnpm --filter @drift/bench run all` and commit the changed files in `docs/evaluation/`.

## Performance

Measured on 2026-09-30 with engine 0.0.0: AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor (4 cores), 15.6 GiB RAM, linux-x64, Node v24.21.0. Memory is the process's peak resident set size, sampled every 25 ms.

### Recorded traffic of growing size

`drift compare` on `examples/petstore/v1.yaml` → `examples/petstore/v2-breaking.yaml`, streaming a generated drift-traffic/v1 file. Memory ceiling fixed in the bench config: **512 MiB**.

| Lines | File | Time | Lines/s | Kept samples | Peak RSS | Within ceiling |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | :---: |
| 1,000 | 0.1 MiB | 102 ms | 9,804 | 1,000 | 133 MiB | yes |
| 10,000 | 0.7 MiB | 166 ms | 60,241 | 4,000 | 164 MiB | yes |
| 100,000 | 7.4 MiB | 650 ms | 153,846 | 4,000 | 265 MiB | yes |
| 1,000,000 | 73.6 MiB | 5343 ms | 187,161 | 4,000 | 330 MiB | yes |

Time per line changes by a factor of 0.05 from 1,000 to 1,000,000 lines (1.00 would be exactly linear; below 1 is better than linear).

### Cached re-run

The same comparison (100,000 lines of traffic) twice with a stage cache: **613 ms** the first time, **13 ms** when Diff, Corpus, Verify and Classify are reused.

### Real-world specs

| Spec | Operations | Ingest | Compare with itself | Changes | Compare with a mutant | Changes (BREAKING) | Peak RSS |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| github-3.0 | 1,224 | 6722 ms | 118 ms | 0 | 109 ms | 2 (2) | 1614 MiB |
| github-3.1 | 1,224 | 6470 ms | 101 ms | 0 | 108 ms | 2 (2) | 1871 MiB |

The mutant adds a required request property (required property driftAdded added at /components/schemas/actions-artifact-and-log-retention for github-3.0); the comparison includes synthetic evidence for every affected operation.

## Accuracy on labelled mutations (DRIFT only)

Each mutation changes one place in a spec and is labelled breaking or safe by the operator that made it (`packages/bench/src/mutations.ts`). DRIFT compares the original with the mutant **without traffic**, so its evidence is synthetic. Specs: `petstore-v1`, `github-3.0`, `github-3.1`, `stripe-3.0`; seeds 0, 1, 2. The comparison with oasdiff arrives in M8.

| Mutations | Total | DRIFT: BREAKING | DRIFT: RISKY | DRIFT: SAFE or nothing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Breaking | 52 | 42 (proven) | 10 (flagged, unproven) | 0 (missed) |
| Safe | 33 | 0 (false BREAKING) | 0 (over-cautious) | 33 (correct) |

BREAKING precision **100.0%**, recall **80.8%**.
